summary: Sable Offshore Corp. filed a 424B5 pricing term sheet for a public offering of 32,467,533 common shares at $3.08 per share and $300M of 6.5% convertible senior notes due 2031. The offerings are cross-conditioned with new senior secured credit facilities and a term loan refinancing. Net proceeds from the common stock offering are estimated at $92.8M, to be used together with note offering proceeds and term loan borrowings to repay existing debt and for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary capital markets financing, not a special situation.
